listing.name: Muscle March Recompiled (tmcleroy)
listing.summary: Explore Muscle March Recompiled (tmcleroy) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Set up the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Get MuscleMarch-android.apk from the project's v0.1.0-beta.5 release. Use an ARM64 device with Android 8 or later. Open the app, choose your own USA WiiWare WAD and supply your own Wii common key as text or a key file, then tap Install and play. The app prepares the game files. The publisher says later starts go directly to the game.

warnings: Portcove has verified the package, but has not tested setup or Play on Android.
